description: Implementation of AppGatewayResponder for WebSocket communication, handling connection setup, authentication, message dispatch, and notifications within the WPEFramework plugin architecture.

classes.name: AppGatewayResponderImplementation
classes.description: Handles WebSocket server setup, client authentication, message dispatch, and connection notifications within the plugin.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Initializes the responder with the plugin shell and sets up WebSocket.

methods.name: InitializeWebsocket
methods.description: Configures and starts the WebSocket server, setting message, auth, and disconnect handlers.

methods.name: GetGatewayConnectionContext
methods.description: Retrieves connection context information (placeholder for future JSON-RPC support).

methods.name: DispatchWsMsg
methods.description: Dispatches incoming WebSocket messages to resolver after verifying app ID.

methods.name: OnConnectionStatusChanged
methods.description: Notifies registered observers of connection status changes.
